frequency_question: How often do such liquidity programs scale up to their maximum projected or announced operational caps within 30 months of introduction?
membership_rule: Includes formalized structural liquidity interventions by the U.S. Treasury or Federal Reserve with explicit multi-tier volume guidance; excludes emergency ad-hoc crisis lending facilities.

cases.name: Quantitative Tightening Balance Sheet Runoff Caps

coverage_note: 6 named; covers all major systematic balance sheet intervention scaling initiatives by US monetary authorities over the past 18 years.
known_gaps: Excludes minor fine-tuning operations like routine overnight repo adjustments which lack distinct structural tiers.
skeleton: 6 major structured intervention scaling cycles since 2008, of which 4 reached their upper volume targets.
validity_reason: Structural mechanics of U.S. debt management and monetary intervention frameworks evolve slowly across decades.
